'''Yarian Kak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] advocate for the [[Metatheran Cartel]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Kak was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], where he was staying in the [[Chancellor's suite (Cularin)|Chancellor's suite]] at the [[Reidi Artom Luxury Resort]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]]. After the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Salld Nrump]] obtained evidence of the existence of three data transmitters that the Cartel had covertly placed on Cularin, Nrump gave a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] containing his findings to the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Kak contacted the agents on the behalf of the Cartel via a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] recording contained within a messenger [[Droid/Legends|droid]], stating that he was authorized to pay them 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] if they handed the datapad in to the Cartel and did not inform the media of its contents.

{{RPG|''[[Blinking Eyes: Quarters|Quarters]]''}}
The agents accepted Kak's offered and they gave him the datapad, and he paid them 20,000 credits in return. Kak made a holorecording of the exchange that was later leaked to the media, causing [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] to hack into the agents' bank accounts and steal the 20,000 credits.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yarian Kak was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and [[Derrel Weaver]], and appeared in ''[[Blinking Eyes: Quarters|Quarters]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure that formed part of the [[Blinking Eyes trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. In the scenario, the players role-play as the Heroes of Cularin and they have the option of choosing whether or not they accept Kak's offer.
